# Vendored front-end libraries

Copied as-is so that pages need neither a build step nor a third-party CDN.

| File | Source | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `preact-htm-standalone.module.js` | https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js | htm 3.1.1 with Preact 10 and hooks |
| `qrcode-generator.js` | https://unpkg.com/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js (MIT, Kazuhiko Arase) | 1.4.4 |
